label: Living: timeless versus present at some time of a duration frame
resolution: The Dei Filius attributes (living conjunct) and the bridge 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1' use LIVING_1, the timeless primitive Primitives.Lives. LIVING_2 (LivesSomeTime: life present at some time of a duration frame) is the conclusion shape of the existing route SelfOperationLife and of STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES. Both readings take life as operating from oneself (q.18 a.3); they differ in the time index, and they are not identified. One statement relates them: the open sense bridge 'Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1' (ad49ea00-287e-4c7c-8ab6-fe222d16d493), restricted to pure act and motivated by the impossibility of a beginning or end of life without potency; the unrestricted bridge (whatever lives at some time lives) is not asserted. Only an argument that lists that bridge in sense_bridges passes from LIVING_2 to LIVING_1 (the second route to the Dei Filius root, deiFiliusRootLivingFromPureAct); its controls show that without the bridge a pure act can be LIVING_2 and not LIVING_1.
